Leaflet 1.9.4, bundled JavaScript and CSS; BSD-2-Clause license in leaflet-LICENSE.txt.
https://leafletjs.com/reference.html
https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4
Terrain provider: OpenTopoMap. Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors and SRTM.
Map style: OpenTopoMap, CC BY-SA 3.0. Attribution is displayed in every map.
https://opentopomap.org/
https://github.com/der-stefan/OpenTopoMap
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
The visible map requests tiles on demand through native zoom 17. No tile archive
or bulk-download operation is included. Coverage and availability depend on the provider.
The embedded Natural Earth overview remains usable without terrain tiles.
